title: Enterprise Non-Production AI Sandbox, Referential Synthetic Data Anonymization & Gateway VCR Cassette Replay Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Cloning Raw Production Databases & Chat Logs Directly Into `Dev / Staging` Environments
tiers.architecture: Copying production customer databases, RAG documents, and chat logs into non-production sandboxes and running live Frontier LLM calls on every CI test

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Random Regex Masking (`XXXX-XXXX` / Faker Without Referential Integrity) + 100% Live Cloud LLM Calls in CI
tiers.architecture: Replacing names/IDs with random Faker strings that break SQL foreign keys and multi-doc joins, while still paying for live GPT-4o/Claude calls on every PR

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Static Hand-Written Mock JSON Responses Only (Zero Live Drift Detection or Realistic Distribution)
tiers.architecture: Mocking all LLM calls with 20 static hardcoded JSON files written 6 months ago; fast in CI, but misses 100% of prompt/schema changes

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Deterministic Keyed-HMAC Referential Pseudonymization + Synthetic Edge-Case Generator + Gateway `VCR Cassette Replay` (`85% Cached / 15% Live SLM/Canary`)
tiers.architecture: Consistent keyed-HMAC entity synthesis preserving SQL/RAG joins (`0%` PII) + Gateway VCR deterministic SSE cassette replay for 85% of CI tests + shared Spot 8B/70B staging pool

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating the 'Non-Production PII Leak' Without Breaking Multi-Table SQL & RAG Joins (`41%` -> `99.6%` Fidelity)
scenarios.question: Developers need realistic customer orders, support tickets, and PDF invoices in `Dev / Staging` to test a Text-to-SQL + RAG agent; cloning production data (`Tier 1`) violates GDPR/HIPAA, while random `Faker` masking (`Tier 2`) breaks every foreign-key join between SQL tables and PDF invoices (`41%` fidelity)
scenarios.model_answer: Use **Deterministic Keyed-HMAC Referential Synthesis (`Subsetting + Consistent Tokenization`)**: map every production entity (`customer_id`, `full_name`, `iban`, `invoice_no`) through a **keyed cryptographic hash (`HMAC-SHA256(prod_val, staging_salt)`) into a realistic synthetic persona** across *both* structured SQL tables and rendered PDF/Markdown RAG test documents—guaranteeing **`0.0%` real PII in non-prod** while preserving **`99.6%` cross-table and cross-document join integrity**!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 exposes real customer PII to 200 developer laptops; Tier 2 maps `Alice` to `Bob` in SQL and `Charlie` in the PDF, breaking RAG-to-SQL tests.

scenarios.scenario: Slashing the '$95K/Month CI/CD & Dev Token Bill' via AI Gateway `VCR SSE Cassette Replay` (`85%` Replay / `15%` Live)
scenarios.question: 200 developers run 1,500 CI/CD integration and E2E test suites per day; calling live frontier LLMs on every unit/integration test (`Tier 1/2`) takes 34 minutes per PR and burns $95,000/month in non-production token fees
scenarios.model_answer: Deploy **Deterministic `VCR (Video Cassette Recorder)` Streaming SSE Replay** at the Non-Prod AI Gateway: hash the canonical request `(model, normalized_messages, tools_schema, temperature=0)`—if the hash matches a recorded golden cassette in Redis/S3 (**`85%` of plumbing/UI/orchestration tests**), **replay the exact recorded SSE token stream at `5ms/chunk` for `$0.00` token cost (`2.4m` CI runtime)**; invoke live LLM endpoints only when the prompt hash changes or during nightly evaluation (`-85.0%` CI token spend, `$21K/mo` total TCO)!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 and Tier 2 pay full frontier API rates to re-run identical plumbing tests thousands of times a day.

scenarios.scenario: Simulating Upstream Cloud Failures (`HTTP 429`, `20s SSE Stall`, `Malformed JSON`) in Non-Prod Fault-Injection Mode
scenarios.question: How do we test whether our application's timeout, retry budget, and fallback logic actually work before deploying to production?
scenarios.model_answer: Enable **Chaos Fault-Injection Headers (`x-ai-sandbox-fault: rate-limit-429 | sse-stall-15s | malformed-tool-json`)** on the Non-Prod AI Gateway VCR proxy: CI tests deterministically inject upstream `429`s, mid-stream TCP resets, and `TTFT > 900ms` brownouts at zero GPU cost!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Live cloud endpoints rarely fail on command during a 5-minute CI run, leaving error-handling code paths untested.

scenarios.scenario: Auto-Expiring Ephemeral Per-PR Vector & Sandbox Environments (`Scale-to-Zero After 2 Hours Idle`)
scenarios.question: Data scientists spin up 40 staging vector indexes and GPU dev pods for feature branches and forget to delete them, wasting $45K/month in zombie non-prod infrastructure
scenarios.model_answer: Provision **Ephemeral Namespace/Collection Sandboxes** tied to the Git Pull Request lifecycle (`pr-482-vector-collection`) with **KEDA Scale-to-Zero after 30 minutes of inactivity** and automatic teardown upon `PR Merge / Close` (`-87.3%` non-prod TCO)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Long-lived per-developer staging GPU pods sit 96% idle overnight and on weekends.

key_findings: Tier 4 (Deterministic Keyed-HMAC Referential Pseudonymization + Gateway VCR SSE Cassette Replay `85% Cached / 15% Live` + Ephemeral PR Sandboxes) achieves 0.0% non-prod PII risk, 99.6% join fidelity, and 2.4-minute CI test runs at $21K/mo (-87.3% vs Tier 1).

Random Faker masking (Tier 2) breaks foreign-key joins between SQL tables and unstructured RAG documents (41.0% fidelity), whereas keyed-HMAC persona synthesis preserves 99.6% cross-system referential integrity.
Replaying recorded SSE token streams via content-addressed VCR cassettes eliminates 85% of redundant CI/dev LLM token bills and cuts test suite duration from 34 minutes to 2.4 minutes.
